rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for doing something by one's own choice rather than under pressure.

example.english: I am doing this work voluntarily; nobody is forcing me.
example.traditional: 呢啲工作我係自己願意做嘅，冇人逼我。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 gung1 zok3 ngo5 hai6 zi6 gei2 jyun6 ji3 zou6 ge3 mou5 jan4 bik1 ngo5

rows.note: Use this especially when describing voluntary participation, consent, or enrollment.

example.english: They voluntarily took part in this volunteer activity.
example.traditional: 佢哋自願參加今次義工活動。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 zi6 jyun6 caam1 gaa1 gam1 ci3 ji6 gung1 wut6 dung6

rows.note: Use this when the person not only agrees freely but is also genuinely willing and unresentful.

example.english: I voluntarily look after your dog.
example.traditional: 我心甘情願幫你睇住隻狗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sam1 gam1 cing4 jyun6 bong1 nei5 tai2 zyu6 zek3 gau2
